text.description_html:
Acorn BH3BI, 6' Distressed Barn Door Kit with Squared Mounts

The rustic styling of the Hammered Steel Barn Door Kit for 36 Inch Doors adds an extra layer of detailing that really sets it apart. It is made from steel and is available in an array of finishes including black for a truly old-world look and hard-to-find bold colors like white and red. This barn door hardware kit with 6 foot tack comes with everything you need to hang a 3 foot door.

Features of the Acorn BH3BI, Hammered Finish Barn Door Hardware:

  • Kit package includes everything you need to install a barn door.
  • Made from steel for durability and strength.
  • Anti-jump track blocks.
  • Available in 9 brilliant colors.

Specifications of the Barn Door Kit with 6' Track:

  • Track: 6 feet (72 inches)
  • For doors up to 3 feet (36 inches)
  • For wood doors up to 300 lbs.
  • Package Includes: 6' track, wheel Carriers, standoffs, end stops, anti jump blocks, and door bottom stabilizers.
  • Acorn Sliding Barn Door Kit Installation Instructions (PDF)

In case of a doorway larger than 3 feet, custom length tracks are available. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Finish option Flat Black is in stock for immediate shipment. Please Contact Us for current estimated delivery times on all other finishes. All other finishes are special order and NOT RETURNABLE.
